Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019)
Description: The Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019) framework issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Requirements.Name: CCG-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Governance
Requirements.Description: Cloud security policies and administrative least-privilege boundaries must be enforced.

Requirements.Name: CCD-1 Cloud Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), password complexity, and API key management.

Requirements.Name: CCD-2 Cloud Data & Storage Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect Object Storage and Block Volumes using OCI Vault encryption and private access.

Requirements.Name: CCD-3 Cloud Network & Perimeter Defense
Requirements.Description: VCNs, Subnets, and Security Lists must prohibit open internet access on management ports.

Requirements.Name: CCD-5 Cloud Threat Detection & Vulnerability Management
Requirements.Description: Enable Cloud Guard and vulnerability detection across OCI compartments.

Requirements.Name: CCD-6 Cloud Logging, Auditing & SIEM Ingestion
Requirements.Description: OCI Audit logs must be retained for at least 365 days and event rules monitored.
